name: Wanted: Maggot Eye
summary: In Brill, the Forsaken leadership has posted a death bounty for Maggot Eye. The notorious gnoll robs nearby graveyards and farms, supplying bodies to the Lich King's Scourge. Executor Zygand demands proof of the kill to secure the lands around Garren's Haunt.

sections.title: A Grave Crime
sections.body: In Tirisfal Glades, the dead do not rest in peace. Maggot Eye faces a severe death sentence for aiding the Lich King. Gnolls are usually seen as savage brutes driven by hunger, but Maggot Eye digs up corpses and gathers remains to strengthen the Scourge army.

sections.title: Justice in Brill
sections.body: The Forsaken fight to break free of the Lich King's control, so feeding their dead kin to the Scourge is among the gravest offenses. Executor Zygand oversees local military enforcement in Brill and ordered the bounty to end the grave robberies near Garren's Haunt. To claim the prize, you need Maggot Eye's paw as proof that the beast can trouble Tirisfal no longer.

faq.answer: Maggot Eye is an infamous gnoll prowling northern Tirisfal Glades. He raids farms near Garren's Haunt and gathers corpses for the Scourge, making him vile even among his kind.

faq.q: Why do the Forsaken want him dead?
faq.answer: The Forsaken sentenced Maggot Eye to death for supplying looted corpses to the Lich King's Scourge army. Keeping soldiers and resources from the Scourge is vital to Forsaken survival.

faq.q: Where is Maggot Eye usually found?
faq.answer: Maggot Eye lurks in an old ruined hut at Garren's Haunt, a ruined farmstead north of Brill.

faq.q: Who pays the reward for the bounty?
faq.answer: Executor Zygand, in the center of Brill, accepts proof of the kill and pays the town's reward on behalf of the Forsaken military authority.

faq.q: Why does Executor Zygand want his paw?
faq.answer: Executor Zygand wants Maggot Eye's paw as unmistakable proof of death before the bounty is paid.

faq.q: Are gnolls allied with the Scourge?
aliases: do gnolls work for lich king
faq.answer: Gnolls generally act on their own out of hunger and greed, but Maggot Eye supplies dead bodies to the Scourge, making him a dangerous collaborator.

angles.text: As an Undead, you know every corpse Maggot Eye steals is a fallen sibling enslaved again by the Lich King. Stopping him defends the Forsaken and answers a personal wrong.
As a member of the Horde, you need Tirisfal's northern borders secure to hold Lordaeron against Scourge remnants.
